close_reason: Added tests/blob_smoke_tests.rs with 4 smoke tests covering both Blob methods: blob_lookup (threads ids + typeNames + USING_BLOB capability assertion for the Blob/* family + typeNames:null when None + empty blob_ids rejected), blob_convert (ImageConvertRecipe wire shape with all four fields + CALL_ID-keyed response decode + USING_BLOB + width/height omitted when None + empty content_type rejected). All 4 pass; clippy -D warnings clean. Note: blob.rs already had unit tests for ImageConvertRecipe wire format, BlobConvertResponse deserialisation, and the extras-preservation policy across all four blob types — these new wiremock tests complement those by exercising the end-to-end SessionClient call path.
description: Create tests/blob_smoke_tests.rs covering: blob_lookup (threads ids, decodes BlobLookupResponse), blob_convert (creates conversion job, decodes converted blob via CALL_ID-keyed created map). Spec: RFC 9404 / urn:ietf:params:jmap:blob (verify the actual capability constant in mod.rs; could be USING_CHAT or a separate USING_BLOB).
